name: corridor
short: Shared services and office state for pixel-agents-cogs.
description: Owns shared reply and permission settings, LLM and A2A infrastructure, registered agent tools, and the two opaque revisioned office-state aggregates used by the cctv pages. Other cogs consume these services through required_cogs.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores bot-owner configuration for the shared LLM, A2A and MCP services, and per-server reply style and permission groups (role IDs, not user IDs). It also holds the office-state store: each Discord account's office character (a pixatar seed code and the character profile it stands for, keyed by user ID) and its seat in each server's office and the editor office; pixelagents deletes those records on a data deletion request. Prompts, Discord conversation content and tool results the agent cogs send through it go to the configured LLM endpoint, A2A agents and registered MCP servers; corridor does not store them.
install_msg: Shared infrastructure every other cog except switchboard needs. Hidden from [p]cog list: install it by name next to them, and they load it automatically. Outside services: LLM requests from the agent cogs go to a LiteLLM endpoint (default https://litellm.nntin.xyz/) once a key is set; it runs the A2A HTTP listener (127.0.0.1:8931 by default; it accepts only the bot's own agent cogs, which hold a token minted on each load) and connects to MCP servers other cogs register. Setup (bot owner): [p]corridor llm endpoint/key/model and [p]corridor a2a host/port; permission groups and reply style: [p]corridorsettings. If a cog later fails to load with an import error from typing_extensions, another install upgraded a pinned package: run [p]pipinstall "pixel-agents-deps @ git+https://github.com/pixel-agents-hq/pixel-agents-cogs@pixel-agents-deps-v1#subdirectory=requirements" and restart the bot.
